$comment: FR-WIKI-06 secret guard for the vault autocommit. Single source of truth read by BOTH
Regex dialect: the common subset of JavaScript (no flags) and Rust `regex` — ASCII literals,
[...] classes, (...) groups, |, {n,m}, ^ and $. Do NOT use \s, \b, '.', lookaround or flags.
filename: tested against the repo-relative path (e.g. vault/sub/.env.local) after ASCII-only
lowercasing, so write these patterns in lowercase; `unless` (optional) is tested the same way and
cancels a hit. Paths are handled as byte strings (one char per byte) in both engines.
content: tested against the exact blob bytes the commit would contain, decoded one char per byte
(latin1), and again with every NUL byte removed (catches UTF-16LE/BE text with or without a BOM).
A path with any `filter` attribute (git-lfs, a custom clean filter) is ALSO scanned pre-filter:
its working-tree bytes, the content the user wrote, get the same content rules.
ignoreAsciiCase patterns must be lowercase; they are tested against an ASCII-lowercased copy.
selfTest vectors are asserted by both test suites.
limits.maxScanBytes: a candidate blob, or the working-tree file of a path with a `filter` attribute,
larger than this is never committed; it is skipped as too-large-to-scan (fail closed). 64 MiB matches
the vault ingest limit (PRD OQ-16) and keeps both engines well inside their memory/string limits.
